objective: Hide ended schedules and rebuild the weekly schedule list as a date-ordered timeline with type filters (R91, R94), and add an admin character template delete/reset action (R92).
acceptance_criteria: WeeklyScheduleList hides schedules whose end_date is before today (KST) and keeps schedules ending today.
Weekly list has a filter bar (All, Pickup with All/New/Rerun/Ongoing sub-chips, Version, Contents, Broadcast).
Each week card shows a date-ordered timeline with date column, TODAY badge, avatar with game badge, title with type badge, game name, period, D-n, and favorite toggle; weekly expense section is kept.
Admin character tab offers a template delete action that warns about N regular characters, deletes them, resets classification_schema to empty defaults, and keeps pickup-only characters.
tsc, lint, and Vitest pass with tests covering the new behavior.
